peak_shear.part: Adhesive on the ledge of step 2

words: The pick solved as a slice under 100 N/mm: largest bondline shear 11.72 MPa, largest peel stress 4.117 MPa.
As the load grows, the adhesive reaches its elastic limit in shear first, at 256 N/mm.
That is at or above the 230 N/mm named: the slice holds the pick.
headline: Under 100 N/mm: largest bondline shear 11.72 MPa (hand calculation 12.85), largest peel 4.117 MPa; first, the adhesive reaches its elastic limit in shear at 256 N/mm
